name: Compressor failure when powered but no cooling
description: Power is on but cooling is not happening → compressor / start-circuit issue.

action.solution: Test start relay and overload protector. Replace compressor if start-circuit OK.

name: Refrigerant gas leak
description: Frost build-up + hissing noise + cooling loss → refrigerant leak.

action.solution: Call a licensed technician. Do not attempt to recharge refrigerant yourself.

name: Condenser coil dust buildup
description: High temp + grinding noise from rear → dirty condenser coils.

action.issue: Condenser coils likely dirty or fan obstructed
action.solution: Vacuum condenser coils at the back/bottom. Clear any debris blocking the fan.

name: Fan motor failure (temp high, fan not running)
description: Room hot + indoor fan silent → fan motor or capacitor failure.

action.solution: Inspect fan motor windings and run capacitor. Replace if resistance is out of spec.

name: AC refrigerant low
description: Cooling weak + ice on copper line → low refrigerant.

action.solution: Pressure-test the system, locate leak, repair, then evacuate and recharge.

name: AC condensate drain blocked
description: Water dripping inside + cooling OK → drain line blocked.

action.solution: Clear drain pipe with a wet/dry vac or compressed air. Pour a 1:1 vinegar-water mix to dissolve algae.

name: Drum bearing wear
description: Loud grinding during spin → worn drum bearings.

action.solution: Replace bearing kit. Inspect drum seal and spider arm while disassembled.

name: Drain pump clogged
description: Water won't drain + no spin → drain pump obstruction.

action.solution: Open the pump filter (usually front-bottom-right), remove lint/coins. Check impeller for obstructions.

name: Battery degradation while charging
description: Charger plugged in but battery remains low → degradation or charging circuit fault.

action.issue: Battery degradation or charging circuit fault
action.solution: Run battery health check; replace battery if cycle count > 500 or health < 80%.

name: Phone thermal throttling
description: Phone hot + sluggish → thermal throttling or runaway process.

action.issue: Thermal throttling or runaway background process
action.solution: Close all apps, reboot in safe mode, scan for malware, avoid using while charging. If persistent, factory reset.

name: Laptop thermal shutdown risk
description: High CPU/GPU temp + fan at max → cooling failure risk.

action.issue: Cooling system degraded — thermal shutdown risk
action.solution: Clean vents and fans with compressed air. Re-paste CPU/GPU. Replace thermal pads. Verify fan bearings.

name: Laptop storage failure imminent
description: Disk SMART failing + I/O errors → imminent data loss.

action.issue: Storage device failing — back up immediately
action.solution: Back up critical data now. Clone the drive if still readable. Replace drive and reinstall OS.

name: Laptop RAM pressure
description: RAM usage sustained above 90% → memory pressure.

action.solution: Close heavy apps, disable startup programs, consider RAM upgrade if maxed out.

name: Generic gas / smoke detection
description: Any device reporting gas presence → safety critical.

action.issue: Gas or smoke detected — safety hazard
action.solution: Ventilate the area, shut off gas supply if safe, evacuate, call emergency services.
Inspect rotating components for imbalance, looseness, or wear. Re-torque mounts.
